name: ss
description: Ship Shape (ss): technical skills for building software, invoked as /ss:<skill>. The flow is shape → build → ship (/ss:shape settles the acceptance criteria, the build is the work itself, /ss:ship lands the branch), with project facts kept as approved lines in the repo's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md by /ss:record-fact, and /ss:review, /ss:review-setup, /ss:diagnose, /ss:gather-branch-context, /ss:caretake, /ss:takeover, /ss:research, /ss:write-readme, /ss:orchestrate and /ss:correct alongside, and situational skills an agent loads when their trigger in references/triggers.md fires. It never merges, with one exception: /ss:orchestrate merges a PR only on the person's explicit authorization, given in their own conversation, and under the repository's rules.
